WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM Employee
  WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM grouped
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    g.ReportsTo,
    g.count,
    g.count / t.total_count as share,
    1.0 / t.num_groups as avg_share
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  ReportsTo,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as diff_from_avg
FROM with_shares
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Empty" ReportsTo values are interpreted as SQL NULL, based on the column definition DEFAULT NULL
